$comment: Owner-approved, time-limited dependency-audit exceptions. Read by web/scripts/audit-gate.mjs; rules in web/scripts/lib/audit-policy.mjs; record in docs/web/dependency-audit-exceptions.md. An entry that expires, goes obsolete or stops matching the verified dependency graph FAILS the Dependency audit job. Never add an entry without the owner's recorded decision.

exceptions.rationale: minimatch >=7.0.0 <11.0.1 can be driven into a denial of service by a crafted glob (CWE-405). The only vulnerable copy is minimatch@10.2.6 under @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, reachable only through the typescript-eslint toolchain used by eslint-config-next (a devDependency that is never bundled): the production audit reports 0 vulnerabilities, and the glob patterns are repository-authored configuration (allowDefaultProject) and file paths. No compatible fix exists upstream: the latest typescript-estree (8.72.1) and its canary pin minimatch ^10.2.2 and npm audit fix proposes a breaking downgrade of eslint-config-next. The only patched line is minimatch >=11.0.1.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove this entry as soon as the audit no longer reports GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 for web/ (the gate fails an obsolete entry on its own). That needs a release of @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree (via typescript-eslint / eslint-config-next) that accepts minimatch >= 11.0.1. Re-check upstream before 2026-12-15; the exception is not renewed automatically and the gate fails closed from 2026-12-16 00:00 UTC.
exceptions.amendment: NARROWING ONLY (pending the owner's confirmation in the pull request; no new risk accepted): GitHub narrowed the advisory's vulnerable range from <11.0.1 to >=7.0.0 <11.0.1. The six minimatch@3.1.5 paths and the direct root eslint are no longer vulnerable; only minimatch@10.2.6 under @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree remains. Expiry, severity and scope are not extended.
